caveats: Bubilet individual event pages display day/month/weekday but omit year in their text. Years are established from current upcoming listings and a matching calendar; each row documents this. Biletix handball pages explicitly show 2026.
Only future dated events are included, with no recurring attractions, archived events, combined passes or made-up dates.

57 dated sessions comprise 56 unique production/day titles. Feridun Düzağaç has two real separately ticketed shows, in Alanya and Antalya on consecutive days. The three handball days are separate ticketed sessions.
Coverage is concentrated in Antalya city; Alanya and Manavgat are included, but this is not province-wide comprehensive coverage.
Prices, end times, accessibility and age restrictions are not asserted; link visitors to the provider for these changing details.
No source images copied because reuse rights were not verified.
Read results are search-index/cached primary page extracts; latest crawl ranges from today to six days for included event pages. Recheck ticket provider before attending.
